scientific_integrity: The source derivative identities and accumulation-interval theorem are credited to their authors; the new result concerns all subsequential time-histogram measures and explicit distribution functions.
scientific_limitations: Only the permitted Nakano–Soma–Yamamoto piecewise expanding maps and full-measure regular wandering orbits, with both components of the tangent vector nonzero. Empirical measures are over observation times, not invariant orbit sampling. Independent mathematical and publication-priority validation not undertaken.
title: Complete subsequential histogram laws for Lyapunov-irregular wandering orbits
